title: Debt and Cover
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Xanthe Amberdale, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
